The '''Republic Operations Center''' was the main base of operations for the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Quesh]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] and [[Galactic War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].
